_doc: THE AWAY-DAY MANIFEST (CYBORG_BRAIN.md §9) — the ONLY jobs a cloud runner may execute. LOCK 1: every job MUST carry public_safe:true; scripts/awayday.mjs refuses the whole run if even one lacks it. LOCK 2 (10 Aug 2026): a flagged job whose command names the personal lane is refused too — a flag is a claim, the command is the evidence. CORRECTED 10 Aug 2026: this line used to call the flag the SECOND lock, on the grounds that his private state was excluded from a cloud checkout by the ignore rules. That stopped being true on 5 Aug (captain decision D10, re-confirmed 10 Aug) — personal state is TRACKED in this PUBLIC repo by his own ruling, so a cloud checkout DOES carry it and these two flags are the ONLY locks. Never re-assert the old one from memory; the runner reads it live and prints it on every run (node scripts/awayday.mjs exposure).
